visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character in a blue shirt is seen from the chest down, sitting at a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor restaurant. She uses black chopsticks to lift a large portion of thin white noodles from a deep gold-colored bowl which also contains seaweed. To the right, small black condiment dishes are visible on the table. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a modern food court storefront with a queue of approximately five customers waiting. The signage above the counter displays various menu items with bright LED lighting. The floor has a light-colored wood grain pattern. (3) The perspective returns to a close-up of food. Chopsticks pick up a piece of cooked chicken sautéed with red and green peppers and onions, dripping with savory sauce, and place it onto a small gold bowl of white rice. (4) A white ceramic spoon scoops up a creamy, beige-colored soup from a gold bowl containing chicken and goji berries. The background shows a well-organized wooden tray holding multiple dishes. (5) Close-up of beef noodles featuring several large, thin slices of braised beef garnished with chopped green onions. The narrator uses chopsticks to lift thick, wavy noodles coated in a rich brown sesame sauce. (6) A white spoon lifts a large piece of dark red duck blood and a square of tofu from a spicy red broth. (7) The video concludes with a static graphic overlay showing the restaurant's logo and address information over a blurred background of the mall interior.
